notes: Operations Console QoL: Admin now includes a compact local System Health panel covering SQLite quick_check, simulation time/pause state, Ollama/model readiness, desktop supervisor/server status, backup state, update-staging leftovers, and local log availability. Backup history is visible with version/date/size/file counts, while destructive restore/delete remain intentionally unavailable. A new Copy Support Bundle action collects the safe troubleshooting snapshot, system health, and bounded tails of launcher/server/Ollama/updater logs for one-click troubleshooting; nothing uploads automatically and hidden world truth remains excluded. No Simulation authority, citizen behavior, world truth, or autonomy changes.
